title: Relating to the exercise of eminent domain for a demonstrated public necessity; limiting certain condemnation powers; requiring independent review, public hearings and county elections, enhanced compensation, repurchase rights, and revenue accounting; providing court review, injunctive relief, recovery of costs, and enforcement; contingent in part on a constitutional amendment.
